_comment: Column knowledge for metadata/conversations.tsv, consumed by tools/csvw/generate_csvw.py. Column *sets* differ across modules (confirmed: KIP has 11 columns, KIPasti/ParlaBO/ParlaTO/Stra-* add languages/collection-region/macro-region/etc — see tools/PIPELINE.md 'Known module differences'), so this is a lookup of descriptions/datatypes by column name, not a fixed ordered list. The generator reads each module's actual header and applies whatever entries match; unmatched columns pass through undescribed rather than failing.

type.dc:description: Conversation type. Not a closed set across modules — e.g. KIPasti has finer-grained subtypes like 'free-conversation:meal'.

participants-relationship.dc:description: Commonly asymmetric|symmetric, not enforced as a hard constraint.

collection-point.dc:description: Module-specific set of site codes (e.g. BO, TO).
